about: v5 narration. `text` is shown in captions; `say` (optional) is what the voice reads (same words, respelled for pronunciation); `rate` and `pitch` direct each line's delivery.

lines.text: 5:34 in the morning. The hostel is asleep. And somewhere in this building, one device is about to tell a lie.
lines.say: Five thirty-four in the morning. The hostel is asleep. And somewhere in this building, one device is about to tell a lie.

lines.text: Before your laptop talks to the internet, it asks the whole network one question: who's the router?
The real one, a MikroTik downstairs, answers with its address. Your laptop writes it down, and sends everything there.
lines.say: The real one, a Micro-Tik downstairs, answers with its address. Your laptop writes it down, and sends everything there.

lines.text: Here's the catch. Nobody checks that answer. Whoever replies... gets believed.
At 5:34 and 3 seconds, a device in this building started replying: I am the router.
lines.say: At five thirty-four and three seconds, a device in this building started replying: I am the router.

lines.text: The laptop believed it. So did two others nearby.
71 packets went out. Zero came back.
lines.say: Seventy-one packets went out. Zero came back.

lines.text: From the inside, it looks like this. Discord at 5,000 milliseconds. Your friends can't hear you. Pages load... forever.
lines.say: From the inside, it looks like this. Discord at five thousand milliseconds. Your friends can't hear you. Pages load... forever.

lines.text: No error message, either. An error needs a reply. Nothing replies.
Pulling the cable ended it. On a phone hotspot, a different network, the internet came straight back.
lines.say: Pulling the cable ended it. On a phone hot-spot, a different network, the internet came straight back.

lines.text: And a little monitor called netbug had recorded every second.
lines.say: And a little monitor called Net-bug had recorded every second.

lines.text: At 3:28 that afternoon, it happened again.
lines.say: At three twenty-eight that afternoon, it happened again.

lines.text: Same device.
Same address.
Same lie.
42 packets out. Zero back. Four more devices lost the router.
lines.say: Forty-two packets out. Zero back. Four more devices lost the router.

lines.text: And this time, the capture caught it shopping for a victim: looking up a device it had already cut off that morning.
Not a broken router. Not a bad cable. Someone is doing this. On purpose.
And it wasn't just me. A friend down the hall ran netbug too, for four days.
lines.say: And it wasn't just me. A friend down the hall ran Net-bug too, for four days.

lines.text: Every time it plugged in, the impostor was already waiting. Six outages. The longest: 37 minutes.
lines.say: Every time it plugged in, the impostor was already waiting. Six outages. The longest: thirty-seven minutes.

lines.text: So netbug grew teeth.
It watches every second, and logs any device that claims to be the router.
Press Test and pin. The real router passes traffic and answers as itself. The impostor can't. The real address gets pinned, and fake replies just bounce off.
The attacker can also lie to the router about you. So netbug reminds the router who you are. Every second.
lines.say: The attacker can also lie to the router about you. So Net-bug reminds the router who you are. Every second.

lines.text: On the friend's laptop: pinned at 6:31 that evening. The next nine minutes: zero failures.
lines.say: On the friend's laptop: pinned at six thirty-one that evening. The next nine minutes: zero failures.

lines.text: If the internet freezes with no error, and everyone around you drops too: switch to a hotspot. The impostor can't follow you there.
lines.say: If the internet freezes with no error, and everyone around you drops too: switch to a hot-spot. The impostor can't follow you there.

lines.text: Better: run netbug, and press Test and pin.
lines.say: Better: run Net-bug, and press Test and pin.

lines.text: But a pin protects one laptop. The real fix belongs to the hostel.
Find this device on the MikroTik. Then turn on client isolation and ARP inspection, so a lie like this never gets through again.
lines.say: Find this device on the Micro-Tik. Then turn on client isolation and A.R.P. inspection, so a lie like this never gets through again.

lines.text: Know who your router is.
